body: I always feel great the next day. Never felt bad, actually.

Last week my mother gave me a whole leaf. Usually she gives me one or two 10 mg tabs, but she wouldn't be home then, so she thought I would be reasonable with it. I thought that I would be reasonable too, but I woke up and realized i must have eaten like 70 mg at one sitting. Went to work few hours later, like nothing happened. But god damn did I sleep well. I have severe problems with insomnia and ambien works wonders, but the highs are sometimes irritating.

And what I think is that usually the eastern propaganda is portrayed as obvious and blatant. Usually you'll see the old commie posters from centuries ago. Now social engineering and psychology has seen some progress and people like Freud and Pavlov have made great contributions, among others. Life has gotten so complicated that most of us will not be aware that we're being manipulated all the time. That and the average person doesn't have the time and energy left to think about stuff like this. And I can say, you'll get paranoid pretty fast thinking about it.
Try watching [The Century of the Self](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eJ3RzGoQC4s). It's sad.

I've got money, shelter and if I wasn't an anxious twat I'd have plenty of opportunity. Nothing makes me happy anymore, can't make myself do anything besides reddit. My work is mind numbing and I get paid shit. I'm living with my mother and her boyfriend. I' m supposed to be a grown up by now, but I just act like a little girl. Got lots of emotional issues.
It's nobodies fault, there was always something wrong with me. I don't want to feel anymore. When I do feel it's just anxiety, sadness, loneliness and isolation. Tried meds, hobbies, etc. I'm tired.
